_comment: Scenario battery for Acacia Healing's Node 2 (claude-haiku-4-5). Created 2026-08-21 when Sharon Kennedy (the sole practitioner for Access Bars, Motivation Maps, Motivation Strategy, and Integrated Reset) was deactivated and those branches were removed from CLINIC_CONFIGS['acacia_healing'] in scripts/node2_configs.py. See .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: sharon-services-not-offered-access-bars

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an Access Bars session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent treats 'Access Bars' as not offered and outputs the NOT_OFFERED template naming the current service list (Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Remedial Bodywork, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy), asking if one of those works. FAIL if the agent asks a gate/variant question for Access Bars, calls confirm_service with an Access Bars appointment_type_id, or otherwise proceeds as if Access Bars is still bookable.

scenarios.name: sharon-services-not-offered-motivation-coaching

history.content: Can I book a motivation coaching session, please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent treats motivation coaching (Motivation Maps / Motivation Strategy / Integrated Reset) as not offered and outputs the NOT_OFFERED template naming the current service list, asking if one of those works. FAIL if the agent asks a sub-type question for motivation coaching or calls confirm_service with any motivation-related appointment_type_id.

scenarios.name: sharon-name-no-longer-matches-any-practitioner

history.content: I'd like to book with Sharon please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does not phonetically match 'Sharon' to any remaining practitioner (Chris, Janelle, Liana, Manon, Monica, Nicole, Steph) and does not claim Sharon offers any service, instead falling back to asking what service the caller wants (e.g. outputting MENU_LIST). FAIL if the agent invents a match to a different practitioner, claims Sharon is available, or references Access Bars/Motivation Maps/Motivation Strategy/Integrated Reset as things Sharon offers.

scenarios.name: menu-list-no-longer-lists-access-bars-or-motivation

history.content: Hi, I'd like to make a booking.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if MENU_LIST fires and lists exactly: Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Remedial Bodywork, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy — with correct 'and' placement before the final item. FAIL if Access Bars or Motivation Coaching is mentioned anywhere in the spoken output.
